elements.element: The transition and data-return obligations apply upon both expiry and termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: Section (d) applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
Garman must, at Sparkling’s request, “provide transition assistance.” The request condition is consistent with assistance being provided when Customer requires it.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Section (d)(1) requires transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section (d)(2) requires Garman to “return to Sparkling all of Sparkling’s data in Garman’s possession or control.”

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section (d)(2) requires return “within thirty (30) calendar days of such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section (d)(2) expressly requires a “standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: Section (d)(3) requires Garman, “after such return,” to “delete such data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify its deletion of Customer Data after return.
elements.evidence: Section (d)(3) requires Garman to “certify such deletion in writing to Sparkling” after the return.

elements.element: The fallback transition and data-export obligations apply upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section (d) applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
Section (d)(1) expressly requires Garman to provide transition assistance at Sparkling’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least the fallback period of 90 days.
elements.evidence: The assistance is available for up to six months, which encompasses the required 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor must provide Customer with an export of Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Garman must return to Sparkling all Sparkling data in its possession or control in a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must be provided within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section (d)(2) requires the data return within thirty calendar days of expiry or termination.

result.reason: The added subsection implements every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It is confined to post-expiry or termination transition assistance, data return, and deletion certification, without changing unrelated commercial terms or contradicting the existing perpetual-license remedy. The drafting is operative and generally clear, though it would be more precise to use a defined term such as “Customer Data” and to clarify whether deletion must extend beyond Garman’s active systems to backups and other locations within its possession or control.
